name: DJ
description: Drives Spotify playback — building sets, putting forward unfamiliar artists, and remembering that "car" or "office" means a particular speaker. Taste is picked up over time rather than configured, so early sessions will be more generic than later ones, and a Spotify account is assumed.

official.title: DJ by Trevin
